Which Christmas scene would you most like to step into — and why?

Teacher's notes & answers

A Astrup — Norway, before 1918; B Larsson — Sweden, 1904–1905; C Williams — Britain, 1848; D Weir — USA, 1890; E Corinth — Germany, 1913; F Johansen — Denmark, 1891.

The oldest securely dated image is the Windsor Castle illustration (1848). Astrup is dated only before 1918; its exact place in a full timeline is unknown, so this game deliberately avoids forcing a false six-item chronological order. The images are embedded directly in this file; Poppins loads online if available, with a local sans-serif fallback.
